Лютеин + зеаксантин.about: Macular carotenoids: antioxidant; slow down age-related macular degeneration, but do not save you from screens.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.caution: Lutein and zeaxanthin are retinal carotenoids. For age-related macular degeneration (AMD): systematic reviews show improvement in macular pigment and slower progression. For cataracts: risk reduction. For retinopathy of prematurity: Cochrane (40292760). AREDS2 formula (lutein + zeaxanthin) is the standard for AMD. Dose: 10 mg lutein + 2 mg zeaxanthin/day. Safe.
effects: AMD is slow; “blue light screens” - marketing (not confirmed)
Лютеин + зеаксантин.food_sources: Spinach, cabbage, egg yolk, corn, pumpkin are bioavailable with fats; taking them with oil is mandatory.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.guidelines: MA 2019: MPOD +0.07, pungency +0.28 (10–20 mg); nuclear cataract RR 0.63–0.73; AREDS2-dose 10+2 mg; premature - no.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.how_to_choose: AREDS2 dosage - 10 mg lutein + 2 mg zeaxanthin with fatty food; buy not “formulas”, but composition.
mechs: AMD is slow; “blue light screens” - marketing
Macular pigment density: linear with dose (10–20 mg/d)
Antioxidant in the lens: reduction of nuclear cataracts
Antioxidant Protection of Prematurity (ROP): The Claim
Retinal protection has not been confirmed in preterm infants (Cochrane 2025)
Лютеин + зеаксантин.myths: “They save you from blue screens” - protection from the monitor has not been proven. “Help prematurity” - ROP risk not reduced (Cochrane 2025).
Лютеин + зеаксантин.name: Lutein + Zeaxanthin
Лютеин + зеаксантин.onset: The density of macular pigment grows over months, faster by 20 mg; There is no effect in days.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.title: Lutein + Zeaxanthin
Лютеин + зеаксантин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Лютеин + зеаксантин.who_needs: People with age-related macular degeneration (AREDS2) and familial risk; for nuclear cataracts - observational data.
